rules.expected: Candidate-specific mappings, optimization provenance, stationary-point validation and explicit coverage/stopping evidence are present.
The first-stage alternatives have a clear reported relative-free-energy ordering with units and uncertainty.
The second-stage alternatives and sequential connection to final product are explicitly compared and mapped.
Electronic selectivity evidence is specific to reactive sites and separated from thermodynamic claims.
The final conclusion supports selective dibenzo[a,o]picene formation within scope and states limitations against kinetic/excited-state overclaiming.
